_comment: Hand-curated CONFIGURATION, not a golden artifact: it records which extracted
surface entries the Android app strictly decodes, so their removal/change
classifies BREAKING (everything else is ADDITIVE inventory drift).
Keys are '<layer>/<name>'; 'layer/*' sets the layer default. schemas names are
'<file>#<Symbol>' with the file deciding consumption; channels entries are
'<Map>.<Key>'; slash entries are bare command names; limits/enums are bare names.
Basis: the app decodes the zcode-protocol-v4 spine + workspace-config (Phase 2),
catalog with /compact + /goal mapped to v4 commands (Phase 2), the task-mode
vocabulary (Phase 1 GAP-17), and the PROTOCOL_V4_LIMITS transport geometry.
usage-stats.ts (the desktop monitor plane) is deliberately NOT consumed —
the phone reads the agent-DB usage aggregate instead (Phase 3 GAP-5 note).
Desktop ServiceChannels are desktop-internal IPC names: tracked, not consumed.
